description: This file defines a utility enum 'ExecShellWrapperParser' in Swift that provides functions to parse command-line strings and detect if they are wrappers for shell commands. It includes logic to recognize different shell types (posix, cmd, powershell) and extract embedded commands from wrapped invocation commands.

classes.name: ExecShellWrapperParser
classes.description: A static utility enum for parsing shell wrapper commands and extracting inline commands from various shell invocation patterns.

classes.name: ParsedShellWrapper
classes.description: A struct representing the result of parsing a command: whether it is a shell wrapper and the extracted command string.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Public static method to extract and identify if the command list is wrapped by a shell, returning a ParsedShellWrapper struct.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Private static method to extract the inline command payload based on shell specification.

methods.name: extractPosixInlineCommand
methods.description: Private static method to extract inline command from posix shell commands.

methods.name: extractCmdInlineCommand
methods.description: Private static method to extract inline command from Windows cmd commands.

methods.name: extractPowerShellInlineCommand
methods.description: Private static method to extract inline command from PowerShell commands.
